note: FH.3 symbolic paths. A NestJS controller whose prefix is a TS enum member (`@Controller(RouteKey.User)`) or an `as const` object member (`@Controller(ApiPrefix.Admin)`), and a method path that is a template over an enum member (`@Get(`${RouteKey.Album}/shared`)`), all declared in ANOTHER file. ts_routes keeps each symbol as a `~const:<symbol>~` placeholder segment and the post-cache path fold resolves it through the const table, which reads TS enum members since FH.3. Baseline 2026-10-26 (HEAD 6b82d110, debug CLI): ROUTEs `PUT /me` and `GET /stats` (the prefix dropped), no `/users/albums/shared` route at all (a template path was dropped), and no HTTP_CALLS: the client's fetches of `/users/me`, `/users/albums/shared` and `/admin/stats` paired nothing. Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: typescript/http is already scored.
